scope: Completed raw epoch300 ROI and transfer weights, identical two strong B36 batches and one weak B36 batch; CPU FP32 batch BN, no optimizer updates. Backbone/neck run under no_grad; measured gradients are at neck outputs, final classification features and shared classification tower parameters. Original ROI weights use identical indexed loss plumbing and a counterfactual transfer term only for measurement.
limitations: Endpoint, training-image probes do not establish the entire optimization history.
Infinitesimal gradient directions are not finite AdamW updates or AP effects.
Backbone/neck parameter gradients are outside this measurement.
Weak and strong pipelines use some of the same source images; these are 108 input views, not 108 independent original images.
